# Human Tribes

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## The Old Tribes

The world is wider than the Human race. Some peoples are born with arms twice as long, some with legs that never tire, some with a third eye, and on one island in the Calm Belt, a nation of warrior women.

Be of the Long-Arm, Long-Leg, Kuja or Three-Eye tribe.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of one of the Human Tribes

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-530acb11d4cf783b"></a>

## Far From Home

Your tribe's island is small. The sea is not.

Reach 1,500 Doriki and sail into the Grand Line.
